highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 brings Skia m154, more reliable GPU failure handling, and packaged compiler XML documentation.

breaking.title: Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp corrects CCC133 to CCC132, retaining numeric value 132 but providing no compatibility alias. Replace source references to UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132.

breaking.title: Replace GlyphFlags.Defined masks
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp removes GlyphFlags.Defined and does not expose the other aggregate Defined masks. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead of using an aggregate of every flag in one HarfBuzz release.

breaking.title: Use an external RAW decoder
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to milestone 154 without changing the C API. HarfBuzz remains natively at 14.2.1; package revision 14.2.1.400 reserves the new milestone servicing line.

Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and GPU-buffer upload failures. Unsupported asynchronous readbacks complete with a null result rather than leaving work unresolved.
Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.
Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
Uno views depend on the matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly native-assets package, avoiding missing-symbol links caused by combining current managed bindings with an older archive.
Updates supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag values from the bundled native source without introducing new managed types.
Ships compiler-produced XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, making source-authored API documentation available to package consumers.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Corrected the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Opened the Skia m154 line. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1 despite the new package revision bucket.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Added packaged compiler XML and synchronized HarfBuzz enum values, including the CCC132 rename and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined. Corrected glyph-atlas, GPU-upload, Windows BinSkim, and Uno WebAssembly asset issues.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX embedded-preview extraction; use an external RAW decoder when needed.

harfbuzz_summary: Synchronizes supported enum values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1, renames CCC133 to CCC132, and removes GlyphFlags.Defined; update those source references. Packages include compiler XML, and Windows native assets correct the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m154 line while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: Preview 2 added packaged compiler XML, synchronized HarfBuzz enums, and corrected glyph-atlas, GPU-upload, Windows BinSkim, and Uno WebAssembly issues.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: The release candidate removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

v4.154.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.
